newsitem.title: USA: Mosaix names Tiliacos president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Mosaix names Tiliacos president, COO.

text.p: Mosaix Inc said Thursday it named Nicholas Tiliacos president at chief operating officer, replacing Kamran Kheirolomoom, who resigned but will continue to serve in an advisory roll.

Mosaix, which makes enterprise customer management solutions, said Tiliacos will oversee the integration of its sales, support and service operations to focus on opportunities in call centers and enterprises worldwide.
Tiliacos previously served as senior vice president and general manager of the company's call center group.
